content.text: [{"name":"place","summary":"Place a new column, beam, wall or slab on a storey (storey-relative mm)."},{"name":"move","summary":"Move elements by a vector d = [dx, dy, dz], mm."},{"name":"copy","summary":"Copy elements, moved by d = [dx, dy, dz] mm, with new GlobalIds and names."},{"name":"delete","summary":"Delete elements."},{"name":"set_generator","summary":"Change an element's sizes (width, height, length, depth, thickness), mm; missing ones are kept."},{"name":"set_view","summary":"Change a view's scale (1:N), true_north, crop (null: none) or plan range offsets, mm; missing ones are kept."},{"name":"set_schedule","summary":"Change a schedule's grouping by level, family filter (null: every family) or columns (field names); missing ones are kept."},{"name":"set_material","summary":"Give elements a material: a model material's name or a library grade (\"C35/45\")."},{"name":"set_note","summary":"Write a one-line note on an element (the property \"Note\"); an empty text removes it."},{"name":"set_project_field","summary":"Set one project information field by its label (the key is made from it); an empty value removes it."},{"name":"rotate","summary":"Rotate elements by angle_deg about the vertical axis through about = [x, y] mm (default: the centre of their origins)."},{"name":"mirror","summary":"Mirror elements in the vertical plane through axis.point along axis.dir; placements stay right-handed."},{"name":"add_sheet","summary":"Add a sheet (default: the next free number, \"New sheet\", A1 landscape) with a new GlobalId."},{"name":"set_sheet","summary":"Change a sheet's number, name, paper (A4..A0), portrait or revision; missing ones are kept, an empty revision removes it."}]
